demo.title: hunch-bet.sh
demo.code:
# Discover live markets for a token or a phrase (the only source of which markets exist)
curl -s "https://www.playhunch.xyz/api/partner/discover?q=%24BNKR"

# Quote a side and size before betting: implied price, fee, shares
curl -s "https://www.playhunch.xyz/api/partner/quote?marketId=<id from discover>&side=yes&sizeUsd=5"

# Bet (x402: the first POST returns a 402 for exactly the stake; resend with X-PAYMENT)
curl -s -X POST "https://www.playhunch.xyz/api/partner/trade" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"marketId":"<id from discover>","side":"yes","sizeUsd":5,"walletAddress":"0xYourWallet","idemKey":"<uuid>"}'

setup: Base wallet + USDC; bets start at $1 with no Hunch maximum (Bankr's own limits apply), paid to the pinned settlement address
Discover first with `GET /api/partner/discover`, then quote with `GET /api/partner/quote`
Bet with an idempotency key and the x402 payment header via `POST /api/partner/trade`; every bet returns an on-chain proof
